name: weighted mean modulus residual
population: fixed role-excluded native spectroscopic-logg/Teff color/magnitude overlap intersection
weights: two separately refitted overlap models inside same fixed IDs; with/without d_ref
question: sensitivity to conditioning variables at the same statistic and eligibility
limitation: different weights define different overlap target distributions; not a causal FeH coefficient

name: weighted marginal median modulus residual
formula: weighted marginal median(delta_mu|poor) - weighted marginal median(delta_mu|ordinary)
weights: same saved weights as the corresponding weighted mean
question: change of statistic only
limitation: weighted marginal median is not a conditional mean or paired individual median

name: reference absolute magnitude
population: same source roles and independent spectroscopic phase; common luminosity/precision domain or stated magnitude-complete slice
weights: with/without d_ref, same support per domain
question: reference-population luminosity difference at comparable observed colors
limitation: r limits/reference precision/Mr cuts restrict the estimand; spectral distances and FeH share teachers

name: magnitude-complete slice
formula: r16..18, Mr4.5..5.5, mu11.5..12.435, EBV<.03, formal gr/depth and reference precision cuts
population: bounded reference-selected luminosity and distance rectangle
weights: same design comparison on this fixed domain
question: sensitivity under a region complete with respect to the stated observed-r window
limitation: not complete with respect to spectroscopy, Gaia selection, metallicity, or all luminosities; outcome truncated

name: signed Gaia anchor
formula: integral of frozen full distance PDF times signed-parallax Gaussian likelihood / its actual SNR-window acceptance
population: same role/phase/color criteria, actual Gaia states4/5/6; negative parallaxes retained
weights: paired sky-bootstrap score differences; no reference-distance inversion or FeH slope fit
question: independent observation-space direction of a predefined -0.2/0/+0.2mag scale change
limitation: selected reference cohort, not a universal calibration of all survey objects

name: known-system scale
population: same current common members, fixed reference-CMD lower-MS or turnoff region
weights: one member multiplicity matrix and one reference-scale vector per system, shared across all groups/methods
question: transfer of one M13 lower-MS zero point to the other systems
limitation: historical development ancestry; GD1 curve covariance unavailable; single-star intervals conditional on point zero point
